_doc: Live DIR Est ids (qtvDir, without the direction digit) -> count station in count_stations.json (key 'ROAD@PR'). Last digit of a live id is the direction: 1 = sens 1 (+, increasing PR, towards Luxembourg on A31), 2 = sens 2. 'source': refDir.csv (official), manual, or auto-match (from recordings, see backend/app/dir_matching.py).
